metadata.label: Investigation
metadata.description: An investigation represents a unit of research. You can have multiple studies within an investigation, each representing a different aspect of your research. Please provide the necessary information for your investigation and its related studies.

steps.title: Investigation Information
texts: Please provide the following information about your investigation.

fields.label: Investigation Identifier
fields.explanation: A descriptive identifier for your investigation.

fields.label: Investigation Title
fields.explanation: A descriptive title for your investigation.

fields.label: Investigation Submission Date
fields.explanation: The date when your investigation was submitted.

fields.label: Investigation Public Release Date
fields.explanation: The date when your investigation was made public.

fields.label: License
fields.explanation: The license under which your investigation is released.

steps.title: Investigation Publications
texts: Please provide information about the publications related to your investigation.

component.label: Publications
component.explanation: Add publications related to your investigation.

steps.title: Investigation People
texts: Please provide information about the persons involved in your investigation.

component.label: Authors
component.explanation: Add people involved in your investigation.
